summary: AI利用の最小共通運用(明確なAI stance、AGENTS.md等の共有指示、小batch、version control、CI safety net、内部platform)をteamで定め、AIが増幅する既存の悪い工程を先に是正する。AI導入前に工程の欠陥を直すかは組織判断。

evidence.summary: DORA 2025(約5,000名): AIは増幅器で強い組織をより強く、弱い組織の問題を顕在化。7 capabilities(clear AI stance、healthy data ecosystem、AI-accessible internal data、strong version control、small batches、user-centric focus、quality internal platforms)。高品質platformとAI価値に相関
DORA AI Capabilities Model: 各capabilityの実装戦略・開始tactics・監視方法を提示(本文は要download、本調査ではpage概要のみ確認)
DORA: tool sprawlの最小化、社内codebase/docsとの接続、production readinessに合わせた計画調整

agents-md (public, reputation established): read the raw SKILL.md at getsentry/skills skills/agents-md: it inspects package manager, commands, CI workflows, policy docs and conventions, then writes a root AGENTS.md under 60 lines with a Commands table, External References table, Key Conventions and a Commit Attribution rule, symlinking CLAUDE.md instead of maintaining a divergent copy — the remedy's 'shared instructions such as AGENTS.md defined once for the team'.

applies_when: 複数人がAIを使い品質がばらつく
AI導入で速度は上がったがdelivery/stabilityが改善しない
not_applicable_when: 個人開発でteam差が存在しない場合(J17は残る)

expected_effect.primary: 利用者Skill差によるばらつきを共通下限で抑え、AIが増幅する対象を良い工程に揃える
metrics: team内PR品質分散(差戻し率・revert率の個人差)
AI stance/共有指示の遵守率

risks: 過剰な標準化で熟練者の効率を下げる
policyだけで工程の欠陥は直らない
cost: policy/共有指示は数時間、工程是正・platform投資は数週間以上
known_failure_modes: AIをtool導入だけで工程改善の代替にする(DORA: AIはteamを直さない)
structural_note: J17(悪い工程の高速化)はAI側の対策では解消せず、工程・組織習慣の是正という人間の判断が前提。

matched_on: creates and maintains the team's shared agent instruction file (AGENTS.md, with CLAUDE.md symlinked rather than duplicated)
derives the instructions from the repository's real commands, CI workflows, conventions and existing policy documents
one root file plus nested files only where a subtree genuinely differs, so every contributor's agent reads the same baseline
requires AI commits to carry a Co-Authored-By attribution line
keeps the shared file short and reference-backed so it stays current

alternates.why_not_primary: In the shared checkout at plugins/agent-instruction-maintenance/skills/maintain-agent-instructions and already installed in TechLog; it audits AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, rules and commands for staleness, duplication and contradiction, and requires a single product-neutral body linked from each product's search directory. That is the maintenance half of the same leg, but it improves instructions that already exist rather than establishing a team's minimum common practice, and being org-private it cannot be named to outside readers.

evidence: org-private: https://github.com/shnri/shared-agent-plugins (not publicly obtainable); consumer copy installed in TechLog

alternates.why_not_primary: Templates a team-wide development process and coding convention document covering Git strategy, PR process, test strategy, review process and CI automation — the closest thing to the remedy's 'minimum common operating practice' — but it contains no AI stance and no AI-specific practice, and it is TechLog-local.
